mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive despite UNRATE rising > 0.5% in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive despite GDPC1 declining for 2 consecutive quarters in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite INDPRO rising > 1% in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative despite FEDFUNDS decreasing in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% in a month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite RSAFS declining > 2% in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative despite PAYEMS rising > 200,000 in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase and retail sales (RSAFS) decrease simultaneously, it signals a shift in consumer spending from goods to housing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises and RSAFS declines simultaneously
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite the simultaneous rise in HOUST and decline in RSAFS in more than 50% of instances.
